[Abstracted Experience Guidance]
- Principle 1: Use a leakage-safe regression pipeline (split first, fit transforms on train only, evaluate on held-out data).
- Principle 2: Pair feature selection with residual/error inspection, because good in-sample fit can still hide poor generalization.
- Decision rationale: Model adequacy should be judged by out-of-sample error behavior, not training fit alone.
- Switch condition: If residual pattern remains close to linear and stable, keep a simple model; otherwise move to a more flexible regressor.
- Caution: Common failures include reporting only training metrics and ignoring outlier-driven error spikes.

[Target Task]
I have a regression dataset {{diabetes.csv}}, and the "Target" column of the dataset corresponds to the results. Please use an appropriate algorithm to train and test.
